  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  February 22, 2021

Meeting Place:  Call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
  Meeting ID: 960 5053 9618
  Passcode: 017243
  Time: 9:30 am

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the February 08, 2021, meeting.

  2. Gwynne Pugh Urban Studio – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing architectural design services for the Planning Division.

  3. Hannibal Media Group - Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  preparation for a virtual King Day event for the Parks and Recreation Community
  Services Department.

  4. RSG, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing services in
  review and analysis for the Affordable Housing development for the City.

  5. CHPC Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing paint
  services to the Jail Cell D for the Police Department.

  6. Dewey Pest Control - Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  pest control services for city facilities.
 Closed Session - Confidential
  Closed session-Confidential-Attorney/Client Privileged; Executive closed session Claims
  Review Committee with Legal Counsel regarding pending litigation pursuant to California
  Government Code §54956.9(d)(1)); Johnnie Cox vs City of Inglewood.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.
